description: "A two-part lesson from constrained minimization to Lagrangian duality."

This lesson develops one small optimization problem carefully enough that every geometric and algebraic step can be seen.

::: {.lesson-grid}
::: {.lesson-card}
### [1. A Simple Optimization Problem](1.0-simple-optimization.ipynb)

State a constrained minimization problem, identify its feasible set, solve it analytically, and verify the answer numerically and graphically.

**Prerequisites:** algebra, derivatives, NumPy, and Matplotlib.
:::

::: {.lesson-card}
### [2. Primal and Dual Problems](2.0-primal-and-dual.ipynb)

Construct the Lagrangian, derive the dual function, compare primal and dual bounds, and verify strong duality through the KKT conditions.

**Prerequisites:** [1. A Simple Optimization Problem](1.0-simple-optimization.ipynb).
:::
:::
